              |                             |           |          | line two'::text

Indexes:
    "customers_pkey" PRIMARY KEY, btree (id) CLUSTER
    "Customers Mixed" btree ("Display Name" text_pattern_ops)
    "customers_code_uidx" UNIQUE, btree (code) INCLUDE (name) WITH (fillfactor='70')
    "customers_created_partial" btree (created DESC NULLS LAST) WHERE score > 10::numeric
    "customers_doc_gin" gin (doc jsonb_path_ops)
    "customers_email_key" UNIQUE CONSTRAINT, btree (email)
    "customers_lower_name_idx" btree (lower(name))
Check constraints:
    "customers_score_check" CHECK (score >= 0::numeric)
Referenced by:
    TABLE "events" CONSTRAINT "events_customer_id_fkey" FOREIGN KEY (customer_id) REFERENCES app.customers(id)
    TABLE "gen_ref" CONSTRAINT "gen_ref_fk" FOREIGN KEY (a) REFERENCES app.customers(id) NOT ENFORCED
    TABLE "orders" CONSTRAINT "orders_customer_id_fkey" FOREIGN KEY (customer_id) REFERENCES app.customers(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
    TABLE "orders" CONSTRAINT "orders_referrer_fk" FOREIGN KEY (referrer_id) REFERENCES app.customers(id) MATCH FULL ON UPDATE SET NULL
Policies:
    POLICY "P Update" FOR UPDATE
      USING (
CASE
    WHEN (score > (5)::numeric) THEN true
    ELSE false
END)
    POLICY "p_all" AS RESTRICTIVE
      USING (true)
      WITH CHECK (((email)::text <> ''::text))
    POLICY "p_sel" FOR SELECT
      TO Bob,alice
      USING ((score > (0)::numeric))
Statistics objects:
    "app.cust_stats" (ndistinct, dependencies) ON email, name FROM app.customers
    "app.cust_stats_all" ON email, code FROM app.customers; STATISTICS 50
Rules:
    cust_rule AS
    ON DELETE TO app.customers
   WHERE old.id < 0 DO INSTEAD NOTHING
Disabled rules:
    cust_rule_dis AS
    ON UPDATE TO app.customers
   WHERE old.id < '-10'::integer DO  INSERT INTO app.audit_log (msg)
  VALUES ('updated'::text)
Publications:
    "pub1"
Triggers:
    cust_ctrg AFTER INSERT ON app.customers DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION trg_fn()
    cust_trg BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE ON app.customers FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION trg_fn()
Disabled user triggers:
    cust_trg_dis AFTER DELETE ON app.customers FOR EACH ROW WHEN (old.id > 0) EXECUTE FUNCTION trg_fn()
Triggers firing always:
    cust_trg_always AFTER UPDATE OF email ON app.customers FOR EACH STATEMENT EXECUTE FUNCTION trg_fn()
Triggers firing on replica only:
    cust_trg_replica AFTER TRUNCATE ON app.customers FOR EACH STATEMENT EXECUTE FUNCTION trg_fn()
